episode_summary: npm test failed with a missing script; pnpm test ran the suite successfully.

facts.summary: Run the test suite with pnpm test; npm test exits with a missing-script error in this repository.
facts.details: The repository defines its scripts for pnpm. `npm test` exits 1 with 'Missing script: test', while `pnpm test` runs the vitest suite.
facts.rationale: A failure followed by a resolution with the pnpm equivalent of the same command.
